mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown in both the housing sector and manufacturing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by >0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift toward higher interest rates compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 900, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction (INDPRO < 95), the manufacturing sector slowdown reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
